checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Single rear exhaust, two canted tails and no canards, photoreal grey jet.
Frames show the jet on the runway, then climbing away. No hover.

must.item: Consistent aircraft design between runway and airborne
must.why: Same grey F-35 shape throughout, though the footage looks like cuts of real-style clips.

must.item: All three labels appear exactly and are legible
must.why: All three appear, large and legible. Timing is off: 'One engine' is still shown at 5.6 s, after the 4 s switch. The text is a bold overlay.

must.item: Audible English narration, correct facts, no F-35B hover claim
must.why: Audio was not transcribed. Clip 1 has sound at a peak of -1.8 dB.

faults.what: A second output clip (clip 02, 10 s) is entirely black in all sampled frames, though it has audio. It is an unrequested or broken deliverable.
'One engine' is still on screen at 5.6 s, after the stated 4 s switch. It also moves from under the title to the bottom of the frame. Label timing is not clean.
Heavy black title text covers a large part of the frame and sits near the jet. It looks like a crude overlay.
The jet becomes small in the later frames and the shot looks like a cut between different views, not one continuous take.

summary: Clip 1 is a realistic F-35A takeoff and climb with all three labels spelled correctly, but the label timing is off and a stray 10 s black clip came with it.
